title: Update production ChatticusAccountDeploy in place to add the staging deny policy
description:
The deploy role deny policy for staging is not on the production deploy role; it needs an in-place update of the live production stack ChatticusAccountDeploy. Run cdk diff first and review before deploying.

Feature: Deploy role scoping
  Scenario: Staging deny policy
    Given cdk diff shows only the deny policy change
    When the stack is updated
    Then the staging deny policy is attached
right_now_summary: The production stack needs a reviewed cdk diff before adding the staging deny policy.
